upstream.benchmark_data_sha: source file v3/benchmark_data_v2.json at pinned revision
upstream.paper: Full-Duplex-Bench-v3: Benchmarking Tool Use for Full-Duplex Voice Agents Under Real-World Disfluency, arXiv:2604.04847

primary_source_findings.strict_tool_oracle: The released pass-rate evaluator requires all expected tools, no unexpected tools, and all arguments correct. Without --use-llm it falls back to deterministic exact/normalized argument matching, so the tool-selection/argument core can be evaluated without an external judge.
primary_source_findings.external_runtime_dependency: The released inference path is LiveKit/provider oriented and documents cloud/provider keys for GPT Realtime, Gemini, Grok, Ultravox or an OpenAI cascaded agent. This is NOT an admissible F2 local-acceptance runtime as-is.
primary_source_findings.external_judge_dependency: The optional --use-llm evaluation path invokes gpt-4o for semantic argument/response judging. F2 local acceptance must not use that path.
primary_source_findings.language_gap: The released benchmark statistics explicitly report multilingual_scenarios=0; therefore it supplies no German acceptance evidence.
primary_source_findings.license_gap: CC-BY-NC-4.0 is suitable for bounded research use under its terms but should not be silently copied into a potentially distributable/commercial F2 product benchmark corpus. Preserve source attribution and keep donor material quarantined from product fixtures unless license authority explicitly admits it.

f2_relevance.highest_value_transfer: The benchmark's disfluency + multi-step tool + rollback decomposition is a strong donor for a new original German F2 falsifier family, especially because F2 already has interruption, tool-ordering, stale-result and heard-prefix causal fences.
do_not_transfer: Do not copy the benchmark audio or scenario text into F2 product fixtures.
Do not adopt LiveKit Cloud or provider APIs into local acceptance.
Do not use gpt-4o judging for local acceptance.
Do not infer German quality from English benchmark behavior.
recommended_original_f2_axes: German fillers, pauses, hesitations, false starts and self-corrections
barge-in while a tool is pending
late old-turn tool result after cancellation
German numbers, dates, identifiers and code-switched proper nouns
premature-effect suppression while intent is unresolved
strict no-extra-tool oracle and exact causal result ownership

hypothesis.statement: An original German deterministic benchmark that combines FDB-v3-style disfluency/rollback axes with F2's existing causal identity, heard-prefix and tool-result fencing will expose integration failures that isolated ASR/TTS or ordinary tool tests miss, without introducing external model APIs or benchmark-license contamination.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Existing HF02-HF10 and WP715 tests already cover these interactions sufficiently; the proposed German matrix would add bookkeeping but no new product-negative discriminators.
hypothesis.discriminator: Trigger4 should implement only a small orthogonal pilot and compare whether it produces any new failure class beyond existing HF/WP715 receipts before scaling the matrix.

next_exact_action: Route a small original German deterministic tool/disfluency/rollback pilot to Trigger4 as CANDIDATE_FALSIFIER, reusing existing F2 voice/tool/causal boundaries and existing VPS/controller authority. No new external model runtime, no copied FDB-v3 scenarios, no duplicate HF runtime dispatch.
